quote.text: Que otros se jacten de las páginas que han escrito; a mí me enorgullecen las que he leído.
quote.english: Let others boast of the pages they have written; I am proud of the ones I have read.

poem.text:
Δέδυκε μὲν ἀ σελάννα
καὶ Πληΐαδες, μέσαι δέ
νύκτες, πάρα δ’ ἔρχετ’ ὤρα,
ἔγω δὲ μόνα κατεύδω.
poem.english:
The moon has set,
and the Pleiades. It is midnight.
The hour goes by.
And I lie down alone.
poem.note: Given to Sappho since the Renaissance, though most scholars now think it is a folk song by someone whose name is gone. Four lines outlived their author entirely.
poem.translator: translated for this page, not a published version

painting.title: Nocturne: Blue and Gold — Old Battersea Bridge
painting.note: Ruskin said Whistler was flinging a pot of paint in the public's face. Whistler sued him for libel, won, and was awarded one farthing in damages, which bankrupted him.

song.title: Almost Blue
song.note: Elvis Costello wrote it about a Chet Baker song. Baker then recorded it, near the end, and it sounds like it was always his.
